item.text:
{
  "concerns": [
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0f30f5c64e531a581eb403e4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.89e826cf86d9615660d58ba1fa4436b8289ab3342196bba2167cb71ac403e64c"]}],"rationale":"Authentication and monitoring expectations concern internet brokers and VASPs. They do not establish gift prohibition or identify the proposed second duty. The synthetic dependency and edition uncertainty remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.1ec37b9436d73f758771a614","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.350eb5b7ffbe990d458640be6ed6f3bb09c3d692ed3d8b4056028a4c34ba3bc8"]}],"rationale":"This background heading supplies no operative test for either original question and cannot resolve the synthetic concern.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.dbcb7b0365b22a677ef7a535","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.55e2225714781fd659753c8b8c3013648e40e1fa8405bc28e9111cfbae7c09b3"]}],"rationale":"The phishing prevalence statement is background, not a duty-performance or gift-prohibition criterion.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.14725332f4579b3499499691","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.25b7a56915d7da12ca3144aaeaa1acdde01d0d9d6cbf879bd2d73e12149b578d"]}],"rationale":"The incident narrative explains phishing risks and describes the attack mechanism as suspected. It does not determine either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.4d649e548aefa46fc58413a4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a1423993c515ee8d92ce0f70569785c3ac04e450494eeab93c3b1b64d3fb24b4"]}],"rationale":"The standards heading organizes subsequent expectations; it does not identify the second duty or supply an executable decision.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.3ebfea91adf43d0402437729","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a484cc682d15c2c83015fccb4cfd10a00aff166a56dfef67dc7bc16efdd68143"]}],"rationale":"The general protection expectation introduces several distinct measures. It cannot be replaced with an opaque overall-compliance fact or assigned to the unspecified second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.e58db3d999bc776358947b7b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1b9ac8ede484346d8e55ab709991dc26d5bfe40973c543ddcea30cd18c2e8ca1"]}],"rationale":"Prevention covers both login and device binding. Strong and phishing-resistant authentication requires substantive assessment and does not answer the original gift question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.03797db93f93d94a79778157","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.145e98a99ac601db9f33ae9fe1af43965cac16dcb893aed6b8a41933c030d78e"]}],"rationale":"Detection, surveillance and timely client notifications remain distinct expectations. Their position as section B does not establish that they are the proposed second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.4927b100420f6bae329f9206","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d0826b3879322c937b174d668a241eab57a7b60eaf07c2b8b24ccd0a2268f5de"]}],"rationale":"Incident containment, asset protection, client notification and SFC reporting must remain visible independently of authentication. No performance facts or supported second-duty mapping are supplied.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0cdeb66abe37dd6daffe6083","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bb49153d1b0717e60bc843d40498fc93a2c7b8810723cc68770a06b95b712f60"]}],"rationale":"Client awareness, attack alerts and security guidance remain separate expectations; an authentication result could not account for them.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.ebe60ce31598437b774cb911","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a2c5e83f7d76b4822d82db4f5fd2b36f187e9812324a1df139909749d675933f"]}],"rationale":"The preventive-controls heading provides context but no independent performance criterion for the original questions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.6b7eef21815315b958da1f9d","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.5e4e361fa72dc3e2e6cab57aab9cf169163b03ea9f06db6d3e6ec6cc0951f750"]}],"rationale":"Robust authentication is a qualitative expectation completed by the following login and registration provisions. Its adequacy and mapping to the second duty remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.561857b0a1947720994f1902","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.311689793743089df438d7e50ee195f80f5e1cefa471e14486c2f7bad8c28a0a"]}],"rationale":"Login is one covered process, not the entirety of the authentication expectations or other duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.fd7d2de0842323d099a38762","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d95abf2ca9a711aca136abdd5f83a983799eec45854b57b2b765ddd265b95351"]}],"rationale":"Registration and binding are covered, but existing clients need not rebind devices already bound. This exception must remain and does not exempt subsequent login or new binding from applicable standards.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.9a2c3211c24fdce283bdc008","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.26da04ec2e6068cec850bc3f6d5a82c1f6abea1ee73221b7a28c40a7cc791230"]}],"rationale":"Method selection depends on the firm's circumstances, platform types and risk profiles. The supplied proposal provides no assessment resolving those judgments.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.5ed8bcd483c4e0a1fa7cdc22","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.fad9b58d42de931cc3ff2f0703a306ede7c288cdc9ddd270a5e5bb24e6dd8764"]}],"rationale":"OTP is rejected as phishing-resistant for the specified processes. Timing must also retain the implementation-period provisions and transitional appendix scenario; referenced earlier circulars remain dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.151bbd0f2c394c26f3af5ad9","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.84f31a11d5f63aa22c4a529057216a397cb3ed62ab02c439e94aafd959f642ad"]}],"rationale":"The appendix supplies examples rather than an expressly exhaustive list. Alternative robust methods and their unresolved adequacy criteria must remain visible.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.104e750a1851f3cf1663b248","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.11ab2d0060a128d3af4c9eb0085c78bdc38a03e28fa2b00cfe5081fce918ee48"]}],"rationale":"Passkeys are an example with specified cryptographic and site-binding characteristics. Their use alone does not establish satisfaction of all appendix implementation controls or either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0e7bae377aedd60b4349c79f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.808fdcfeb44f7d91c74cb543e6353e2ba13e4c848a1b27baec0f2d27c27e6640"]}],"rationale":"Bound-device authentication depends on robust verification and applies to mobile and desktop applications. It cannot be generalized without regard to platform or additional-factor requirements.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.b9216d0cc9f8d4404a30571c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bef9f991ee926b7c968462a6c8341058e0d38e3ba64665ca5d8ec7262e8bc7f1"]}],"rationale":"Passkeys and bound devices can support the possession factor. This does not by itself establish completion of two-factor authentication; the referenced requirements remain relevant.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0b0bef7c9756f359168f82c0","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8cb91891bc6b6c782aa2f6bd35f561bed63391de7485ae67356e09c7bab437f9"]}],"rationale":"Passkey unlocking by biometrics or PIN is described as typical, not an exhaustive mandatory implementation. No duty-performance conclusion follows.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.7b3eac73c68f514a9d6bf033","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3c547143651b4c26154267d85dbddc5784cd424dfd99f22d4c65a18bdd5b5178"]}],"rationale":"Device binding requires an additional authentication factor in this login context; the examples do not exhaust the possible factors. The original second duty remains unidentified.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.d43364cb54a8cd5cad510adb","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.50a359179f93f406f4a5063c651d775c373f673ebe8fd96e936ac34984a4acf8"]}],"rationale":"The general three-passkey and/or three-device restriction retains an adequate-assessment route for larger requests. It must not become an unconditional combined cap; referenced current requirements remain dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e07c11ba3ed4b1495787980b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a8ff11cde6e803470d6acf7ba3e5ff49b7c5ceec0f8aafd29fffa18f04f96195"]}],"rationale":"Timeout disabling is disallowed; 30 minutes is an example subject to assessment and monitoring. Longer periods require trading-need justification and close monitoring. These qualifications cannot be replaced by a simple time cap.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.a17f1724ff90272ce14cbad5","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.aedd987c4aa9a64cd6e3672a31e12a06cbaf22f49b0499b97034be7230f9b1f0"]}],"rationale":"Regular reassessment and attention to technological developments remain ongoing expectations scaled to the business. A one-time authentication test cannot establish their performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e1e7c529999827cd4e36b6a3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2ebb9fd7809c81f55428f20c7e3ee01e025f2df0344e04413354590c206741e5"]}],"rationale":"This detection-and-surveillance heading supplies no standalone test and does not identify the synthetic second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0454a928378e32b6bb303a70","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.66c3c7351ec1fed369b15b3190d6e356c86eb13f59f3dbf8361813e74dd0da99"]}],"rationale":"Prompt notifications cover successful logins and specified high-risk events, using multiple channels where applicable. Promptness and channel applicability require assessment; no performance evidence is supplied.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.11c5864c6ae573f4de26479a","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.7814ea8d09c725f8a5687cda3c58871a8935a8217fa39e63dfb19a681044cee4"]}],"rationale":"The firm should remind clients to report suspicious activities immediately. This communication expectation is separate from actual client reporting and from authentication implementation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.f2c32d9483ec4f313f2beba8","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.574c0db77424b54a7a7f183fafd851b0161911a8e47dc6af8891cb74b21f4a93"]}],"rationale":"Client confirmation is strongly encouraged and the new-device check is an example for consideration. Those modalities must not become an unconditional transaction prohibition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0f79c62adea580773804cc85","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.063a2e713ce1d2d34300a9a828b59b76a763e9d3378ffe75ee38c0b423414255"]}],"rationale":"Effective surveillance and prompt follow-up include direct verification and suspension where appropriate. These distinct qualitative and conditional expectations remain unrepresented by the original questions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.668e43db231056cf179f5ea6","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a34deb92c2e02c7afcd76320dea743e9b0f097d8a25afd85e803e8dd13102d71"]}],"rationale":"Transaction monitoring requires predefined thresholds and red-flag analysis. No universal numeric threshold is supplied and none can be invented.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.39d1fb5e3909dce9733e129f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e28e2dc774587ebc0302192867ec7fc22e5bc0b9aa23f1b7065bf051590861b9"]}],"rationale":"Thresholds depend on client profiles, history, account activity, device usage and login patterns as appropriate. These contextual judgments are unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.55063bac309f17a36d8e5b04","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.fff7da1f558d7f4d507c4f7e7dd6dfa4739252a28b6e3ef8395a8fd407b7c19c"]}],"rationale":"This introduction identifies ensuing items as potential red flags, not exhaustive or automatic findings of unauthorized activity.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.abbfff556ca938871ffcdfcc","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c9293a7f1d4b3abe02ca52ac9f8906e02b3418ed83310c24169342d17e9d94e8"]}],"rationale":"Unusual patterns, hours and short-period losses are contextual indicators. The source supplies no fixed loss, time or deviation threshold.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.9b555b3807fd30d3d61c0bb3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bb28c839fbc41efd0627c3cb55bc0986e50cb0b37256ecbe705f50f93820a40f"]}],"rationale":"Unusually numerous trades in illiquid or small-cap stocks are potential indicators; their qualitative boundaries and evidential significance remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e4b96bc08cb5ed8a0ffa5164","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.cdf3bd4122d830dfdc5022101546890d0a6a66d2537144b822e46b2fca221f7c"]}],"rationale":"Unusual transactions shortly after security or contact changes are red flags. Neither a fixed interval nor automatic wrongdoing is established.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.266b266d9d910592106f242f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e61479a012042a638c1d9dc6729c97c03598a65fc04473bce84529f126ee1d19"]}],"rationale":"Sufficient logs, device IDs and timely review remain separate monitoring expectations. Geographic, multi-account and session examples require contextual assessment.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.01ded91cbd8e83d50745186b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.5e83d071dc46d5bdf54274c3f3e64f759c5e46ba70d303a18d556f8e1d78dc70"]}],"rationale":"The response-and-reporting heading organizes subsequent duties but provides no independent performance test.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.52d20c483c622de96cbb0619","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f7e6788ecfccd4ebf4485bf598badecc3aecba1949597aecd96099d356469504"]}],"rationale":"Response procedures must retain immediate containment, asset protection, client notification and prevention of further compromise. Authentication implementation does not establish these procedures or their execution.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.18c1c12871e97da4aa8e5b01","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0814d30bb1cac7e912cf954d59962ebe1e9466911e7142c09d7658f45e04233c"]}],"rationale":"Immediate SFC reporting, root-cause analysis, detailed reports and remedial action remain separate expectations, with external reporting references unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e3b330ce9fb1b10d24e03d51","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f3e0bb1f6949782d39460d3e720d44edf42530c1d8a647069de2b5d356482c13"]}],"rationale":"The client-awareness heading supplies context, not a decision rule for either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.fd3d22675e42f34e2be482c3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3a4fc3f97c39c2a3e3a11b058eea65cc4a32d227acf30b68316467f7f74d7709"]}],"rationale":"Reasonable steps to alert and remind clients require contextual assessment and must be read with the ensuing particulars.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.8ae9a0a4d978729a147c3eda","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.439332d30e22b967bd2f3955972d970b6ee4c154d4c89fefd10336747d6fc34a"]}],"rationale":"Alerts should cover impersonation, fake sites or applications and social engineering. Their performance is not established by an authentication predicate.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.0072e4c7b8defec5b21c5119","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4dec41e1e68624808562599e1a8e9e406136cc7aed0a9080d10e796bf8810112"]}],"rationale":"The firm should communicate compromise risks and credential-protection guidance. This cannot be recast as proof of client behavior or gift prohibition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.d25df565b1f9847dffaad89b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e1d52864e3d8b73392919bbc8e5e8d1001a5d43d804765d3c3522c724549cc51"]}],"rationale":"Regular security reminders include several practices. No fixed reminder frequency is supplied, and these ongoing expectations remain separate from rollout.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.1a463ab700e7b0783ee9d98c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.97ad0028451059a0e83dc5d8d87a4be15bd20f8d3a7a6e7dfbf4904466dc83d1"]}],"rationale":"The timeline heading requires reading the distinct ensuing schedules together; it does not establish one deadline for all duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.ef0c0d2039863a22e63f67ce","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.a8863d91f789f9e729b7a8e130e556cdb62f07d388a7962327a3ff1ac3151bc5"]}],"rationale":"This introductory expectation is completed by the following timing provisions and cannot independently resolve the second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.c20c54f901371219c0d1bba7","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0298773908ae37787540a6b11e543afafc34b647f6345d773fdd08a04930aa99"]}],"rationale":"Sections B–C call for immediate review and necessary enhancement, with a pragmatic assessment approach for system updates. That qualification is not an express automatic extension or exemption.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.00a512e70bc1ba91f633ca12","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.18f50fce3bb71b1384e5b45ad079b07294e9d671a66477c6683fa504911f871a"]}],"rationale":"Client-awareness enhancement is due as soon as practicable. It must not inherit the authentication long-stop deadline or an invented numeric period.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e9ef60359e00024f838cc945","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.97f45b2b7ba2ecd1c94129d7caf7c64757c375bee46fe9a1110b58f8fe51e0d4"]}],"rationale":"Authentication implementation is expected as soon as practicable and no later than 8 July 2027; large internet brokers are expected to act immediately. Large-broker classification, practicability and edition applicability remain unresolved; a date comparison alone would omit them.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.9f11383a73e943a32754b44c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4c7be2936c8db9027a2710de19ddb828de4bb602781b7483cecd5cb5532d9b8f"]}],"rationale":"The implementation period scopes the following transition measures. It does not suspend immediate expectations or resolve the original questions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.9c5bce0d1cd7cea1cf5bb355","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.19c11434cb58cd7b2bac85f58ec4da45efb635b97ecf16f00ebf58718c63d36e"]}],"rationale":"System enhancement includes adequate testing before deployment. The adequacy standard remains qualitative and cannot be inferred from deployment alone.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.8c815d163d4df9e479936053","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.98bccbe3a00dcb5812c9d8b40bb4b1374cb78799e42eb65188a85a1b21b12ee5"]}],"rationale":"Rollout should reach all clients as soon as practicable, while retaining the existing-bound-device exception. Availability to a subset does not establish this expectation.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.338ef1d7a5fa40e97d6e3786","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.5cf40273a88ac6f6b100821da2bd190b955d8ca99af51809ef3c01b5658332c5"]}],"rationale":"Communication, appropriate guidance and support are independent rollout expectations; technical installation alone cannot account for them.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.784cba47166515d86d748662","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c5b5f319af74b1eaa3a51aeef9940508e6377da1423daa68bd0aebd74cd8005c"]}],"rationale":"During transition, enhanced detection remains expected and identified suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity requires immediate suspension or restriction of access. This mandatory response and its trigger cannot be collapsed into the authentication deadline.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.d40dc9504b76321b6636e6f5","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.211321b7e34acd2a59b94d34d0c45b4e07a35eb0c4658d3f54997e769d18b11f"]}],"rationale":"Anticipated difficulty meeting the implementation period triggers immediate notification to the case officer. Notification does not itself grant an extension.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.17b1ccbb29dad8116889068c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c9540f5d5b5ad6769a6f1f3821599c67bf6a8dc5e166e4d0c394d823613b1a01"]}],"rationale":"The management-responsibilities heading introduces separate responsibilities without defining the original second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.a38c25a2bbfe1bab1167a40e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3d739609e177c43a88117b76e05d0a09684461dd0d3f22269dc484a729170098"]}],"rationale":"Senior-management oversight and seeking vendor or expert assistance as necessary remain distinct responsibilities. They are not established by an implementation-date result.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.c625a4cc1dabdb7f15e93cd1","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d14fd1f6f6ab9001d03df4c9848833bd0137ff9b3c96f0dabc07ca22c2a7326e"]}],"rationale":"Adequate internal controls, operational capabilities and stated accountability depend on broader referenced provisions and circumstances. No overall compliance or loss-liability determination is supported.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e77253f3248542a142b57cdb","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4984925d5e969b2ad793e9cc016dbe8bc4ecf8eb692437bdf5d654393e7f308b"]}],"rationale":"Contact information supplies no substantive exception, performance criterion or resolution of edition uncertainty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.7991cde4ad111b08d6544792","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0d53cf67daee837450a794953c7d388b032379aea6ff9e307a5964370ee17591"]}],"rationale":"The division attribution does not resolve the original questions or authenticate the applicable edition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.306def45da7c3d170051bd59","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.7331ed9164a1f9d8d650c24b96b439c5ad5904b251bb17efface975d7c0e2463"]}],"rationale":"The regulator attribution is contextual and does not independently establish the proposed duties, their performance or edition applicability.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.70dd353f1a9935b28d82861d","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8e44403b35b36b6c09feeb80078fd862a231a0ca05bd38dbdc634a8005c8d070"]}],"rationale":"The enclosure marker preserves the need to read the appendix, including alternative verification examples and qualifications; it supplies no standalone decision.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.93f575de507d0a290c02b66f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.439b7303983f74bca3b8496426ae2cec7a7ca5417d4812d6034832a269edba97"]}],"rationale":"The end marker does not remove the following footnotes or appendix dependencies and does not resolve the synthetic concern.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.7fe64f6afd9574f41522defd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.08a437391b573598e036339b36f2be19ae6160c15f6727d20bce99b19d58739f"]}],"rationale":"The document reference is an identifier, not proof of the applicable edition or a substantive test for either question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.c8b1da84754ad659199369cd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.bfddb516318344fa6c28ef37fae089f915fce18195d86fca477e397e134e5f3e"]}],"rationale":"This footnote marker depends on the following internet-broker definition outside this batch. The marker alone cannot establish actor scope or resolve the second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"}
  ],
